report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94ms durations; logs, metrics, and traces show no errors, no 502s, and healthy downstream calls. No anomaly is substantiated, so no root-cause candidate can be scoped. Need baseline thresholds and broader error/latency evidence before diagnosing.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency SLO/threshold for /v1/checkout to determine whether ~63-94ms is anomalous
Error-rate or 5xx evidence over a longer window (only 502 count is 0 in current 60s window)
Downstream dependency latency breakdown (order, inventory, payment, redis, postgres) to attribute latency
Resource saturation metrics (CPU, memory, connection pools) for gateway and downstream services
